description:
RED TRACE

Follow the evidence. Plan the mission.

RED TRACE is an independently developed Mars exploration project focused on making planetary exploration more informed through data-driven investigation and mission planning.

Built by a solo creator, the project combines scientific curiosity, technical development, and analytical thinking to explore the challenges of navigating and operating on the Red Planet.

Every decision begins with a question. Every conclusion requires evidence.

One investigator. One mission. A vision beyond the surface.

© 2026 RED TRACE | Created by Yamen Abed.
summary:
Mars is more than a red dot in the night sky. It is a world with mountains, craters, valleys, and landscapes waiting to be explored.

MARS SCOPE is an interactive Martian exploration platform that brings planetary mapping resources together in one accessible experience. Users can explore the surface of Mars, navigate its geography, and investigate different map layers to better understand the planet's terrain.

Instead of making users search through complicated scientific resources, MARS SCOPE presents exploration through a single interface. The project aims to make planetary science more accessible, encourage curiosity, and demonstrate how technology can turn scientific data into an engaging exploration experience.

The objective is simple: make Mars easier to explore, one location at a time.
details:
The Idea

Exploring another planet should not require navigating complicated scientific databases. MARS SCOPE was developed to make Martian geography easier to access and investigate.

How It Works

MARS SCOPE brings interactive mapping and Martian surface information into one application. Users can navigate the Martian landscape and explore available map layers to investigate the planet's geography and terrain.

Why It Matters

Understanding Mars is an important part of planetary science and future exploration. By making Martian mapping resources easier to explore, MARS SCOPE encourages curiosity and makes scientific information more approachable.

Technology Used

  • Python
  • HTML
  • CSS
  • JavaScript
  • Leaflet
  • NASA planetary mapping resources

Development

MARS SCOPE was developed as an individual project. The focus was on creating a practical, accessible exploration tool that combines mapping resources with a straightforward user experience.

What Makes It Different?

MARS SCOPE focuses on exploration rather than simply displaying information. It gives users an interactive way to investigate Mars and discover its geography through mapping.
